listing.publicRemarks: Amazing New Price! Tucked away on a well-loved cul-de-sac in Moraga, 152 Tharp Drive offers the kind of setting that truly feels like home… where neighbors gather, kids play, and a genuine sense of community thrives. This inviting residence features 3 bedrooms and 3 full baths, along with a flexible bonus area that could easily be converted into a 4th bedroom, home office, or guest suite. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home offers three separate living spaces, providing versatility for relaxation, work, or play. At the heart of the home, the light-filled eat-in kitchen creates a warm and welcoming hub, filled with natural light and ready for your personal touch. Step outside to a spacious backyard with fresh level lawn area, patio and deck, an ideal setting for outdoor dining, play, or creating your dream garden retreat. With endless possibilities to personalize and expand, this property presents a rare opportunity to make it your own in one of Moraga’s most cherished neighborhoods. Ideally located just moments from top-rated K–8 schools, nearby parks, popular swim clubs, scenic trails, and the beloved Moraga Farmers’ Market every Sunday, this home offers an exceptional blend of comfort, convenience, and community living.
